messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-06-23] standup/atlas/2025-06-23: The quarterly capacity review is run by Priya.
- [2026-05-08] incident-review/INC-2026-009: INC-2026-009 review. What happened: scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. Why: two leaders elected during a network partition. Follow-up decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-10-13] standup/cinder/2025-10-13: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki. Reminder that the search indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18-2: Heads-up from the Atlas team: the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.
- [2025-08-29] standup/atlas/2025-08-29: Observation from Atlas: after the client rollout, the product catalog's request volume halved.
- [2025-06-23] standup/cinder/2025-06-23: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-10-16] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (search-indexer, 2025-10-13). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-04-28] incident-review/INC-2025-011: INC-2025-011 review. What happened: the ledger service saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. Why: an index missing after the schema migration. Follow-up decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-06-16] standup/ember/2026-06-16: The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-10-31] standup/atlas/2025-10-31: Team Atlas runs its planning on Tuesdays.
- [2025-02-11] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Review of INC-2025-004 (the notifier, 2025-02-06). The root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. We decided that notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2026-01-01] standup/cinder/2026-01-01: The Cinder team noticed that the search indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2: Team Cinder noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-07-28] standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2: Heads-up from Cinder: the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. Observation from team Cinder: after the dependency bump, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent.
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas/2025-03-10: Dependency map update: the billing service needs the ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-08-01] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Review of INC-2025-017 (the auth gateway, 2025-07-27). The root cause was an expired intermediate certificate. We decided that certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-10-22] standup/dune/2025-10-22-2: Release captain for Q3 2025: Farah.
- [2025-02-28] standup/cinder/2025-02-28: Dependency map update: search-indexer needs the product catalog (product documents). Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-09-15] standup/dune/2025-09-15: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from reporting.
- [2025-12-23] standup/atlas/2025-12-23: The Atlas team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-10] standup/dune/2025-03-10: The reports pipeline depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.
- [2025-09-05] handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-08-29: the scheduler went to Atlas, not team Cinder. Team Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-04-23] standup/atlas/2026-04-23: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2: Atlas saw that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it. The Atlas team noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-08] standup/cinder/2025-04-08: Reminder that the indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
